new_roles.title: Director of Operations-Life Sciences
new_roles.description:
**Who we are:**

Charter Medical, part of the Solesis family of companies, specializes in single-use solutions that enable life sciences innovators to turn bold ideas into lasting breakthroughs, supporting industry-leading companies in bringing life-saving therapies to market. Operating in North Carolina, Charter Medical employs more than 150 team members across two facilities in Winston-Salem.

Guided by a commitment to quality, innovation and customer success, Charter partners with customers to transform promising therapies into commercial realities. Employees contribute to solutions that support life-changing treatments and make a meaningful impact on patients around the world.

**1st shift Monday-Friday 8:00 am-5:00 pm**

**About the role:**

The Director of Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for the site, with full accountability for Profit & Loss (P&L) performance, manufacturing excellence, and sustainable, profitable growth in single-use cell processing and biopharmaceutical manufacturing. The role translates Charter Medical’s mission into operating priorities that advance purpose-built, customizable processing solutions, reduce the cost and risk of delivering advanced therapies, and enable customers to scale reliably. By aligning capacity, capital investment, innovation, quality, and workforce capability with customer demand, the Director fosters a culture of safety, compliance, responsiveness, collaboration, urgency, and continuous improvement—helping biopharmaceutical innovators make life-changing therapies more accessible to patients.

**What you will do:**

* Lead all site manufacturing operations to ensure safe, compliant, reliable, and profitable execution of customer demand.
* Own site P&L performance, including revenue attainment, EBITDA, gross margin, labor and overhead management, productivity, spending, savings, and budget execution.
* Develop and execute the site operating plan and manufacturing strategy in alignment with company objectives, customer demand, and growth priorities.
* Direct manufacturing execution, facilities, maintenance, and continuous improvement activities to achieve Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and People objectives.
* Ensure effective utilization of labor, equipment, materials, information, and facility capacity to improve throughput, yield, lead time, asset utilization, and on-time delivery.
* Establish, review, and act on key performance indicators and performance trends through daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual operating reviews.
* Evaluate and improve manufacturing methods using knowledge of product requirements, materials, fabrication processes, tooling, equipment capability, work methods, and quality-control standards.
* Lead capacity planning and resource allocation to support current production, new business, customer growth, and future site requirements.
* Develop, justify, prioritize, and execute capital investment plans supporting safety, compliance, capacity, automation, productivity, business continuity, and site growth.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, delivery, yield, scrap, labor productivity, cost reduction, flow, and equipment reliability.
* Ensure product availability through disciplined execution of the production plan and alignment of labor, materials, equipment, and technical support.
* Support new-product introductions, technology transfers, pilot builds, process scale-up, design-for-manufacturability reviews, product validations, and commercialization activities.
* Partner with Commercial and Product Development teams to assess manufacturing capability, support customer opportunities, align operational commitments, and respond to changing demand.
* Serve as the senior manufacturing representative during customer visits, business reviews, audits, regulatory inspections, CAPA activities, and issue-resolution efforts.
* Ensure manufacturing execution meets product specifications, documentation, and traceability requirements and supports compliant delivery.
* Build and maintain robust manufacturing training and qualification programs in partnership with Human Resources.
* Develop annual operating budgets, forecasts, staffing plans, productivity targets, and capital plans; monitor performance and implement corrective actions when results fall below plan.
* Oversee product-costing inputs based on actual manufacturing performance, labor productivity, yields, scrap, material usage, and operational assumptions in partnership with Finance.
* Identify staffing requirements; participate in selection and hiring; build organizational capability to meet operational and growth requirements.
* Coach, mentor, and develop operations leaders and employees; establish clear expectations, provide ongoing feedback, manage performance, and support succession and career development.
* Partner with Human Resources to maintain an effective organization structure, conduct talent reviews, improve employee engagement, and develop leadership capability.
* Foster a culture of safety, accountability, quality, customer focus, collaboration, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement throughout the site.
* Ensure adherence to site safety requirements, PPE practices, environmental expectations, and applicable Health, Safety, and Environmental systems.
* Maintain strong communication across shifts, departments, and leadership so priorities, risks, decisions, and customer commitments are clearly understood.
* Act independently with a high degree of judgment and initiative to resolve complex manufacturing and business issues and develop recommendations for senior leadership.

***Please note that Charter Medical does not provide employment visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship both now or in the future.***

**Who you are:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations, business, life sciences, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing experience, including significant experience in a regulated life sciences, biopharmaceutical, medical device, or comparable environment.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in manufacturing management, plant leadership, or director-level role.
* Demonstrated experience owning or significantly influencing a manufacturing P&L, operating budget, productivity plan, and capital portfolio.
* Demonstrated ability to lead managers and cross-functional teams, coach employees, resolve conflict, and drive accountability.
* Working knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices, FDA expectations, ISO-based quality systems, and regulated manufacturing documentation.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production planning, equipment capability, facilities, maintenance, cost drivers, and operational workflows.
* Considerable knowledge of ERP systems and proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Effective written, verbal, presentation, analytical, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work across shared-service and matrixed organizations.
* Ability to use Lean Six Sigma and structured problem-solving methods to improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and business performance.
* Lean Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Experience in cleanroom manufacturing preferred.
* Experience supporting biopharmaceutical customers, customer audits, and contract manufacturing operations preferred.
* Experience leading capacity expansion, automation, technology transfer, or operational transformation initiatives preferred.

**Perks / Benefits:**

* Generous Paid Time Off
* Paid Breaks
* Annual Bonus
* 401(k) with excellent company match
* Health Insurance with multiple plans to choose from
* Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

new_roles.title: Sr. Director Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

At **Link Snacks**, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. We don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. We push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the North Woods of Wisconsin four decades ago.

We’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. Innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. And just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—Jack Link’s®*,* Lorissa’s Kitchen®*,* Golden Island®*,* BiFi®*, and* Peperami® *and* KOOEE!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. What you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the Link Family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.

Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Sr Director of Operational Excellence leads the company's continuous improvement strategy across all manufacturing sites. This role will build the process, capabilities, tools, and governance necessary to create a consistent and sustainable approach to continuous improvement across all factories. The Sr Director will establish a standardized manufacturing excellence framework grounded in lean principles, structured problem solving, loss elimination, standard work, and performance management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the CI change effort. Develop and lead the company’s Continuous Improvement strategy and roadmap across all factories.
* Establish a common CI methodology, tools, governance, terminology, and expectations across the manufacturing network.
* Establish common standards for Lean practices, structured problem solving, daily management, standard work, and performance improvement.
* Establish and advance Lean manufacturing practices including standard work, Kaizen, 5S, value-stream mapping, visual management, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, centerlining, and structured problem solving.
* Develop CI training, tools, playbooks and learning programs.
* Develop a network of plant-level Continuous Improvement champions to accelerate adoption and share knowledge.
* Manage performance. Work with the Plant Leadership Team to track plant targets and KPIs regularly and set action plans and follow-up meetings to close gaps.
* Own KPI visibility. Manage the daily, weekly, and monthly KPI charting and posting process to keep teams accountable.
* Simplify data. Use Power BI and SAP to turn complex operational data into clear, usable information for plant and operations leaders.
* Apply analytics. Use statistics and other analytical methods to identify improvement opportunities and support decisions.
* Track savings. Implement and manage a cost savings tracking process aligned with corporate standards and deliver against savings targets.
* Partner on safety. Partner with the Safety Director to embed safety into improvement work, including incident investigation, hazard reduction, and safety considerations in kaizen events.
* Perform other duties as assigned

 
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in operations, manufacturing, supply chain, business, engineering, food science, or related field, or equivalent experience in continuous improvement.
* 7 to 10 years experience in a manufacturing environment, including a leadership role.
* 5+ years in influencing roles, such as CI, Lean, or support functions.
* Experience or education in statistical process control, root cause analysis, or other analytical methods.
* Training and hands-on experience with value stream mapping, kaizen methods, 5S, leader standard work, and other Lean tools.
* Project management experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver on timelines, budgets, and goals.
* Experience developing or implementing a playbook for a management operating system (MOS) and a continuous improvement program, including how the playbook was rolled out across sites.

**Preferred**

* Experience with SAP and Power BI for operational reporting.
* Experience in food or consumer packaged goods manufacturing.
* Experience with Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), with at least working exposure to its Autonomous Maintenance (AM) and Planned Maintenance (PM) pillars.

**Skill and Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence leaders at every level.
* Diplomacy in communicating needs and recommendations, with credibility that earns trust across functions.
* A proactive style that drives projects to completion despite obstacles.
* A collaborative team approach in all situations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams at once.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

 **Additional Information**

*The salary range for this role is $195,000 - 225,000 annually*

Link Snacks provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Employer** 
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

new_roles.title: Director, Operations
new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

Veolia in North America is the top-ranked environmental company in the United States for three consecutive years, and the country’s largest private water operator and technology provider as well as hazardous waste and pollution treatment leader. It offers a full spectrum of water, waste, and energy management services, including water and wastewater treatment, commercial and hazardous waste collection and disposal, energy consulting and resource recovery. Veolia helps commercial, industrial, healthcare, higher education and municipality customers throughout North America. Headquartered in Boston, Veolia has more than 10,000 employees working at more than 350 locations across North America.

 **Job Description**

**Position Purpose:**

Reporting to and assisting the Veolia Water New York, Inc. Vice President of Operations , this position is responsible for the overall management of the Production and Transmission and Distribution System (T&D) for Veolia Water Westchester, Inc. (VWWC). This individual will provide managerial oversight to the operations, maintenance and construction activities in the Production and the Transmission and Distribution (T&D) Departments to ensure the following objectives are met: departmental financials as they relate to both the budget and approved rate of returns, regulatory compliance, safety, employee development, customer experience, and continuous improvement. This individual is also responsible for managing external relations with municipal and community leaders.

* Revenue - $70 M
* Annual Budget - $32 M
* Capital Budget - $30 M
* Customers – 48,000
* Population Served – 200,000
* Direct Reports – 2 (Manager of Production and Superintendent of T&D)
* Indirect Reports – 62 (non-exempt, non-bargaining and bargaining)
* Budget Accountabilities

**Primary Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Support the Vice President of Operations of the NY Division by developing policy and strategies for VWWC, specifically non-revenue water and asset management.
* Provide direction and management to ensure that VWWC operates in compliance with updated management practices, with data and record retention for auditable trails. Ensure all staff follows Veolia policies and manuals.
* Direct all the statutory and regulatory requirements for health and safety to provide a safe and efficient place of work for our employees. Assist theVice President of the NY Division in providing customers with safe, reliable and adequate service in the most cost effective way.
* Maintain compliance with all company, governmental and/or environmental regulations and policies to provide safe potable water.
* Direct the collection of sufficient data to manage risk and make effective management decisions.
* Conduct appropriate performance reviews to drive results and demonstrate continuous improvement in water treatment, water transmission, construction and distribution.
* Participate in the preparation of accurate and realistic annual operating and capital plans. Monitor Key Performance Indicators.
* Assists in the control of operating and capital expenditures pursuant to the time and monetary schedules contained in the plans.
* Review and analyze non-revenue water statistics, determine appropriate plans and implement agreed recommendations.
* Directs the operations team to ensure the attainment of service, financial goals and major program efforts.
* Ensures the training and cross training of employees through on the job training workshops or schools, evaluation or appraisals, to equip them to perform their assigned duties efficiently and effectively.
* Oversee laboratory process including sampling and testing.
* Assist in employee and career development programs, through ongoing education, seminars and in-house training.
* Participate in labor relations issues including negotiations, grievance, and arbitrations.
* Work with the Regional President of the NY Division with respect to community relations by attending meetings with mayors and town administrators.
* Conduct special studies or analysis as requested by the Vice President of Operations of the NY Division.
* Oversees the Company's fleet maintenance and fleet leasing program.
* May provide testimony in liability and litigation cases.
* Responsible for documenting, developing and maintaining Company's "Emergency Response Plan".
* Keep current with Federal, State and local health regulations.
* Assist with rate case filing including data collection, interrogatories, and testimony.
* Advise, direct and recommend work plan for the long-term main replacement program.
* Direct water treatment, water transmission, construction/distribution related budget items.
* Direct all personnel in stations to ensure proper operating procedures are maintained.
* Ensure timely response to customer water quality inquiries and complaints.
* Direct SCADA operation.
* Participate in the due-diligence process for new business ventures. Includes operations, workforce plans, and customer service. Support, direct, assume responsibility as required for integration of new operations into the NY Division portfolio.

**Work Environment:**

* Office environment.

 
**Qualifications**

**Education/Experience/Background:**

* BS degree in engineering, business administration, or other management is desired or equivalent work experience.
* 7 – 10 years of experience with at least five (5) years experience in a supervisory role.
* Experience in various phases of utility operations, construction, engineering and customer service.
* Thorough understanding of water utility construction and water treatment.
* Experience in a unionized work environment is preferable.
* Knowledge of water treatment methods, distribution system operations and maintenance, Utility accounting systems and procedures.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Proficient Computer Skills including MS Office Suite.
* Excellent Communications Skills both verbal and written. Ability to communicate clearly.
* Excellent Leadership Skills including decision making and planning skills.
* Excellent managerial and supervisory abilities, effective negotiating.
* Organizational Skills.
* Project Management Skills.
* Interpersonal Skills.
* Performance management.
* Required to work under pressure and work on stand-by (24 hr stand-by approximately every 5 weeks).

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to sit at a computer for long periods of time.

 
**Additional Information**

**Pay Range:** $145000 to $160000 Per Year.

**Benefits:** Veolia’s comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

new_roles.title: Environmental Health and Safety Director- Beverage Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**Lassonde Pappas & Co.** is a US Leader in beverage manufacturing dedicated to our team members, customers and consumers satisfaction. We remain committed to our small-town roots and rural values. **Hardworking** and **caring** are qualities that make our teams special. Since 1942, we’ve been producing delicious products for our customers across the country!

To provide the best for our customers, we focus on building the best team by creating and advancing an inclusive environment amongst our diverse workforces. If you’re passionate about customer satisfaction, reliable, and committed to being and doing better, join us!

**We value each of our employees’ total wellbeing. To support employees in all stages of their wellness journey, we have a robust benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage options, growth and development potential, along with 401-K, Life & Disability Insurance, PTO, Tuition Reimbursement, Health Fairs, Gym Membership Discounts, and so much more!**

*Pay Range for this position is: $155,000-$200,000 plus annual bonus, depending on experience and geographical location.*

**POSITION SUMMARY** 
The Environmental Health and Safety Director leads the development, implementation, and performance of health, safety, and environmental programs and policies at Lassonde Pappas & Co. Inc. facilities, to maintain compliance with applicable national and local regulations and to ensure a safe, healthy working environment for all employees. This role reports to the VP of Manufacturing for the US and is based out of our Cherry Hill, New Jersey location.

**Primary Responsibilities include*****:***

* Oversee and ensure the organization’s compliance with local, state, and federal environment, health, and safety regulations including (but not limited to) fire safety and OSHA regulations, and keep up with any changes to laws and regulations that impact the organization
* Work closely with the organization’s legal department to ensure that the company is in compliance with these regulations
* Direct audits and work with each plant and its departments to ensure that all company guidelines are being followed
* Manage the safety budget at the manufacturing sites to ensure that appropriate personal protective and safety equipment is available as needed to prevent injuries and provide for a safe and healthy work environment
* Develop, implement, and evaluate programs, policies, and procedures related to health, safety, and environmental issues in the workplace, and ensure that environmental policy and procedure manuals are available and updated at all times to reduce the risk of injury or illness in the workplace
* Prepare, schedule, and execute training to cover emergency procedures, workplace safety, and other relevant topics
* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring and continuous improvement of environmental health and safety programs
* Conduct risk assessments of work sites to identify potential hazards and formulate plans to mitigate them
* Coordinate with insurance carriers to ensure that appropriate coverage is in place to cover any potential risks
* Review the employee accident reports and medical claims to evaluate the need for potential changes to current policies or procedures
* Consult with engineers to ensure that building designs are safe and compliant with current regulations
* Performs other related duties as required and assigned

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Maintain staff by training employees; maintaining a safe, secure, and legal work environment; developing personal growth opportunities.
* Set objectives, monitor performance, and develop individual training plans to support professional development

* Communicate job expectations; planning, monitoring, and assessing job results; coaching, and counseling employees; developing, coordinating, and enforcing systems, procedures, and productivity standards.
* Establish strategic goals; identifying and evaluating trends; choosing a course of action; defining objectives; evaluating outcomes.
* Set strategic direction and coordinate the work of others to achieve objectives.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

**Minimum Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Environmental Safety, Occupational Safety and Health, or related field required; Masters degree desirable.

* Minimum 8 years working experience in Supply Chain environment in Food and Beverage or other perishable goods
* 5+ years of safety and environmental experience in a manufacturing environment. Experience with a union manufacturing environment is a plus.
* Excellent negotiation skills and the ability to influence others while maintaining professionalism
* Proficient in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook (knowledge in Excel should extend past spreadsheet manipulation and should include creation of formulas)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Detailed oriented and can multi-task
* Excellent time management skills

**Additional Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the food/beverage industry
* Experience in Manufacturing or production environment
* Experience with risk management and project management
* Must pay high attention to detail and have strong interpersonal, communication, and observation skills
* Experience in report writing
* Proven organizational skills
* Ability to direct, coach, and train others
* Consultative, influential, strategic thinking and problem-solving skills

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORKING CONDITIONS**

This position requires sufficient physical ability to work in a typical office setting; driving a motor vehicle and occasionally working in the field/production setting.

**FREQUENT:** sitting, upward and downward flexion of neck; fine finger dexterity and light to moderate finger pressure to include extended periods of keyboard and mouse use, side-to-side turning of neck, walking, standing, bending and stooping, pushing/pulling, twisting at waist, moderate wrist torque to twist equipment knobs and dials.

**OCCASIONAL:** squatting, kneeling, reach above and at shoulder height, moderate grasp to manipulate reference books and manuals; lifting objects weighing 20 – 35 lbs. from below waist to above shoulders and transporting distances up to 50 feet.

**VISION:** Ability to see in the normal visual range with or without correction.

**HEARING:** Ability to hear in the normal audio range with or without correction.

**This job description is not intended to contain a comprehensive list of the responsibilities that are required to successfully perform in this position. Other duties as assigned are part of every job description. The conditions herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential job functions.**

**Lassonde Pappas & Co., Inc provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.**

**This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.**

new_roles.title: Director Operations
new_roles.description:
**About Justrite Safety Group**

At **Justrite Safety Group**, we're more than just a collection of industrial safety companies; we're a dynamic organization dedicated to protecting people, property, and the planet. Our ever-growing portfolio of companies collaborates to deliver advanced industrial safety solutions that set the standard for excellence.

As our business continues to grow, we continue to look for top talent to join our team as we lead the charge in revolutionizing industrial safety, ensuring that every worker returns home safe, every workplace remains secure, and our environment thrives for generations to come. With Justrite Safety Group, safety isn't just a priority—it's our passion.

Temporary, off-site, and transportation-based worksites present unique safety and compliance challenges that our **Jobsite Motion Safety** division addresses with a robust range of portable, durable, and self-contained products. Our jobsite solutions include ground protection, spill containment, wheel chocks, hazardous materials storage, hazard signage, emergency response kits, and safety training resources. By tackling various aspects of jobsite safety, we empower organizations to strengthen their safety protocols, improve operational efficiency, and foster a culture of safety across all locations.

**The Contribution You'll bring to this Role:**

The **Director of Operations** will provide overall leadership and direction for the Broomfield, CO and Titusville, PA sites, ensuring excellence in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and culture. This position will oversee all functions within the facility—including manufacturing, engineering, quality, maintenance, planning, warehouse operations, and EHS—while partnering closely with HR, finance, and corporate leadership to align site performance with business objectives.

This role will drive a customer-focused, LEAN-based culture, fostering continuous improvement, operational discipline, and employee engagement throughout the organization.

In this role, you will report directly to the Chief Operating Officer, setting the stage for your career to soar! This role is your gateway to opportunities for advancement, with the potential to grow within the organization in 3-5 years as you make meaningful contributions to our organizational goals.

**About the Team:**

As a member of our **Operations** team, you will be dedicated to driving efficiency and excellence across all aspects of our business. With a focus on streamlined processes and innovative solutions, they ensure that our operations run smoothly and effectively. Comprised of skilled professionals who are leaders in their field, the team is committed to optimizing performance and delivering high-quality results. Their expertise is key to maintaining our competitive edge and supporting the growth and success of our company.

**What You'll Do at Justrite:**

**Operational Leadership**

* Lead all site operations, ensuring performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity meet or exceed expectations.

* Oversee and develop direct reports including Production, Maintenance, Engineering, Planning, Warehouse, and Quality leaders.

* Establish both short- and long-term operational strategies aligned with corporate objectives and sales forecasts.

* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and use data-driven decision-making to improve efficiency, throughput, and service levels.

**Continuous Improvement & LEAN Transformation**

* Champion LEAN manufacturing principles and culture across all departments.

* Drive standardization, waste elimination, and process improvement through engagement at every level.

* Lead kaizen events and ensure visual management and accountability systems are in place.

**Safety, Health, and Environment**

* Foster a proactive, safety-first culture ensuring compliance with all OSHA, EPA, and local environmental regulations.

* Lead site EHS initiatives to promote a safe, clean, and sustainable work environment.

**People & Culture**

* Build and develop a high-performing leadership team, ensuring succession planning and career development opportunities.

* Promote open communication, teamwork, and accountability.

* Partner with HR to support employee engagement, retention, and organizational development.

**Financial & Strategic Accountability**

* Prepare and manage annual operating and capital budgets, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.

* Drive cost reduction and productivity initiatives while maintaining quality and service standards.

* Participate in strategic planning and contribute to broader business initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for corporate and business unit leaders on all site-related activities.

* Collaborate with supply chain, quality, finance, HR, and engineering teams to ensure alignment on priorities and resource allocation.

* Represent the site in business reviews and support corporate-level projects and new product launches.

**Your Skills and Expertise:**

To ensure your success from day one in this role, Justrite requires the following qualifications at a minimum:

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* Minimum of 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing operations, preferably with exposure to Reaction Injection Molding (RIM), Rigid and Integral Skin Foam, and open cast molding.
* Proven track record of LEAN leadership and cultural transformation in a manufacturing setting.
* Strong understanding of cost systems, production planning, quality management, maintenance, and safety programs.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, foster collaboration, and develop future leaders.

*Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:*

* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams); ERP system experience preferred.

**Compensation:**

The position offers a competitive base salary ranging from $160,000 to $200,000.

Actual base salaries will vary and may be above or below the recommended pay range based on factors such as but not limited to location, relevant experience and performance. Additionally, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan to enhance their overall total compensation package when Justrite Safety Group and their business units achieve annual business and financial targets.

 
Compensation: 140,000 to 165,000

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**HFVCO is hiring a Plant Manager in Winnsboro, TX!**

**Pay:** $130,000-$170,000/year, based on experience 
**Schedule:** Day Shift 
**Location:** Winnsboro, TX 
**Benefits:** Comprehensive benefits package

**About the Position**

HFVCO is looking for an accomplished manufacturing leader to take ownership of plant performance within a food or beverage production environment. The Plant Manager will guide department leadership, oversee financial and operational results, and establish priorities that strengthen safety, product quality, output, reliability, and cost performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Direct plant-wide activities across production, maintenance, quality, warehousing, shipping, and safety
* Establish performance expectations and monitor KPIs for safety, quality, service, productivity, and operating costs
* Own facility financial performance, including budgeting, expense control, P&L results, and capital investments
* Develop department managers and supervisors through coaching, accountability, and performance management
* Lead operational improvement initiatives focused on efficiency, equipment utilization, waste reduction, and plant performance
* Maintain compliance with GMPs, sanitation programs, food safety standards, workplace safety requirements, and applicable regulations
* Coordinate and support customer, corporate, and regulatory inspections and audits
* Identify operational challenges, implement corrective actions, and ensure improvements are sustained

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of manufacturing experience, with food or beverage manufacturing strongly preferred
* Minimum of 2 years of leadership or management experience
* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor's degree preferred
* Experience with facility budgets, cost management, operational metrics, and financial performance

**Join Komatsu and Be Part of Something Big!**

**Job Overview**
----------------

Planning, organizing, leading and controlling all manufacturing related activities of TimberPro Inc. (TPI). Responsible for the performance of departmental functions: Manufacturing, Materials Management, Quality Assurance, Production Planning, CapEx Planning, Human Resources, Facilities Management and supporting Manufacturing Engineering.

**Key Job Responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Develops, reviews, and approves operating plans to achieve production and financial objectives, with accountability for budget control, labor and material efficiency, customer service, order fulfillment, employee relations, and effective workforce utilization.
* Manages Material Resource Planning (MRP), including inventory planning, accuracy, control, and optimization. Coordinates with major suppliers to ensure accurate forecasting, appropriate inventory levels, and reliable component availability to meet production requirements and future capacity expansion.
* Monitors performance against operating plans and standards, communicates results, identifies areas requiring corrective action, and recommends adjustments to achieve operational objectives.
* Develops and presents monthly performance reports as requested by Executive management.
* Develops and implements local policies and procedures consistent with corporate standards, regulatory requirements, OSHA standards, and Komatsu safety requirements, ensuring compliance and a strong safety culture.
* Establishes plant operating objectives and develops short- and long-term plans, budgets, financial forecasts, and resource requirements to achieve business goals.
* Provides oversight for plant cost control, cost forecasting, workforce planning, and facility and capacity requirements, identifying risks and implementing actions to achieve operational and financial objectives.
* Reviews and approves the development and review of all TPI manufacturing budgets.
* Manages facility contracts and third-party service providers, including material disposal, plant and facility maintenance, uniforms, and other site services, ensuring cost, service, and compliance performance.
* Oversees plant budgeting, reviews departmental budget proposals, monitors spending, and authorizes expenditures within established approval limits.
* Reviews and approves major projects involving functional changes within TPI.
* Leads identification and implementation of new manufacturing technologies, automation, processes, and capabilities supporting TimberPro’s long-term operational strategy. Collaborates across Komatsu manufacturing operations to leverage best practices, technical expertise, and solutions that drive improvement in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.
* Consults with management responsible for policy or action, ensures compliance within areas of responsibility, and recommends improvements to policies and procedures.
* Establishes objectives and procedures governing assigned activities. Issues annual objectives to immediate subordinates and reviews objectives of TPI management.
* Builds and maintains an effective plant leadership team through selection, development, coaching, and retention of qualified personnel. Ensures clear roles, responsibilities, and accountability and supports compensation, training, performance management, and succession planning.
* Leads and evaluates direct reports, coordinates activities across functions, identifies training and development needs, and takes appropriate personnel actions to ensure organizational performance.
* Maintains effective communication with employees at all plant levels, providing clear direction, timely feedback, and visibility to business priorities and operational performance.
* Ensures coordination across plant functions and other company organizations, resolving cross-functional issues related to new product development, workers’ compensation, inventory control, and operational performance.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications/Requirements**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree Manufacturing, Engineering or Business Required. MBA or Masters in Engineering or Manufacturing preferred.
* Minimum 3 years’ experience as a GM of Operations in Manufacturing or similar experience.
* Sound administrative skills, well-developed management skills – principles and people.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate across all functions of the organization.
* Working experience in union and non-union environments.
* Experience with Material Management – Bills of Materials, Sourcing, Purchasing, and Inventory Management.
* Experience with new product development and transitioning those products into production.
* Proven ability to recruit, train, and motivate personnel in order to gain profitability and strengthen the organization.
* Honest and trustworthy toward all members of the organization. Use discretion on matters of confidentiality.
* Portray an optimistic and positive attitude in dealings with peers and subordinates.

**Company Benefits**

Komatsu provides an extensive and robust employee benefits package that is designed to enhance the well-being of our employees and family members. We embrace a positive and empowering employee experience with a culture that prides itself on a diverse and inclusive environment.

* Health benefits: Medical, dental, vision, HSA, wellness programs, etc.
* 401k and/or employee savings programs
* Employee time off (vacation and designated holidays)
* Employee and family assistance programs
* Disability benefits
* Life insurance
* Employee learning and development programs

**Diversity & Inclusion Commitment**

At Komatsu, we come from diverse backgrounds, with unique perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We are committed to creating a workforce that is reflective of the communities we work and live in. We believe that our people are part of our shared purpose. Connected by our core values of ambition, perseverance, collaboration and authenticity, we are committed to continually advancing in our support of diversity and inclusion. United, we are on a journey towards a sustainable future that creates value together.

**Company Information**

Komatsu develops and supplies technologies, equipment and services for the construction, mining, forklift, industrial and forestry markets. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Komatsu employs more than 64,000 people worldwide, operating in more than 140 countries. For more than a century, the company has been creating value for its customers through manufacturing and technology innovation, partnering with others to empower a sustainable future where people, business and the planet thrive together. Since the company’s founding in 1921, Komatsu has been committed to supporting individuals and communities through job training, skills development and giving back. As a Komatsu employee, you will be encouraged to grow alongside our global company, contributing to a more sustainable future for all. If you are looking for a company that values your talent and potential, join Komatsu to be a part of something big and help advance modern society. Learn more at www.komatsu.com.

**EEO Statement**

Komatsu is an Equal Opportunity Workplace and an Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

new_roles.title: HW Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Hollister-Whitney (O) – Quincy, IL 62305**

**Overview**
------------

**Level:** Experienced 
**Category:** Salaried

**Description**
---------------

If you are a hands-on manufacturing leader who thrives on the production floor, develops high-performing teams, and drives measurable improvements in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity, we want to talk to you. We are seeking an experienced Plant Manager to lead a designated manufacturing value stream at Hollister-Whitney, part of Vantage Elevation.

**About Us**
------------

Vantage Elevation, LLC is North America’s leading independent manufacturer of elevator components and systems. Vantage is comprised of eight business units, including GAL Manufacturing, GAL Canada, Hollister-Whitney, Elevator Controls, Courion, Bore-Max, Thames Valley Controls, and Vertical Dimensions.

Through its brands, Vantage supplies nearly all electromechanical devices used in contemporary elevators. Founded in 1927, Vantage employs more than 900 people across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

As the Plant Manager, you will lead all aspects of an assigned manufacturing value stream and serve as a key member of the Hollister-Whitney leadership team. You will be accountable for driving performance in safety, quality, delivery, productivity, cost, and employee engagement while developing a high-performing team of supervisors, team leads, and production employees.

This is a highly visible, hands-on leadership role that requires a strong and consistent presence on the manufacturing floor. You will work closely with Engineering, Quality, Materials, Supply Chain, Maintenance, Environmental Health and Safety, Human Resources, and Customer Service to achieve production and business objectives.

The successful candidate will be an accountable, people-focused leader who uses data, Lean principles, and disciplined execution to deliver sustainable results. This role is ideal for an ambitious manufacturing professional who is motivated to grow into broader plant leadership responsibilities over time.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

A typical day may include:

* Lead the daily production activities of an assigned manufacturing value stream, ensuring production plans are executed safely, efficiently, and in alignment with customer commitments
* Drive performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and employee engagement using operational metrics and disciplined corrective action
* Maintain a visible presence on the manufacturing floor, remove production barriers, and optimize labor, equipment, materials, and other resources
* Lead, coach, and develop Production Supervisors, Team Leads, and hourly employees while establishing clear expectations and accountability for results
* Build a culture of safety, quality, collaboration, respect, and continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with OSHA requirements and company policies
* Lead safety observations, incident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective actions to reduce workplace hazards, defects, scrap, and rework
* Champion Lean Manufacturing practices, including Kaizen events, waste reduction, and initiatives to improve throughput, OEE, labor utilization, inventory accuracy, and first-pass yield
* Manage labor efficiency, overtime, productivity, manufacturing costs, departmental budgets, and improvement opportunities that support profitability
* Partner with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Materials, Maintenance, EHS, Human Resources, and Customer Service to resolve challenges and achieve business objectives
* Lead organizational change with urgency, sound judgment, and a strong focus on employees and customers

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and manufacturing leadership experience
* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience
* At least five years of experience leading supervisors and hourly production teams
* Demonstrated success leading production in a heavy industrial manufacturing environment, such as metal fabrication, machining, welding, capital equipment, industrial equipment, or engineered products manufacturing
* Proven ability to improve safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and overall production performance
* Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives
* Strong business acumen with the ability to manage operational metrics, budgets, and financial performance
* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and develop employees and frontline leaders
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Sound judgment, emotional intelligence, and the ability to lead effectively through change
* Proven ability to influence others and drive accountability across functional boundaries
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and ERP systems

### **Preferred**

* MBA or advanced technical degree
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Experience with ERP systems such as Infor, SAP, Oracle, or a comparable platform
* Experience working within an ISO 9001 quality management system
* Experience in a union manufacturing environment
* Multi-site manufacturing leadership experience

**Benefits of Working With Us**
-------------------------------

* Competitive base salary of $110,000-$140,000 (commensurate with experience, qualifications, and market conditions)
* Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* 401(k) with Company Match and Non-Elective Contribution
* Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Annual Incentive Compensation Program (ICP)
* Career Development and Growth Opportunities
* ...and more

**Position Details**
--------------------

* Full-Time
* First Shift
* Location: Quincy, IL—on-site at Hollister-Whitney
* Member of the Site Leadership Team
* Direct supervision of Production Supervisors, Team Leads, and production employees
* Reports to the Vice President and General Manager

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

Vantage Elevation, LLC provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind in accordance with applicable laws.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
Dairy Farmers of America (DFA), a dairy marketing cooperative owned by more than 12,500 family farmers. Our mark matters and it represents the wholesomeness of dairy that we share with our communities and loved ones. DFA manufactures a variety of dairy products, including cheese, butter, fluid milk, ice cream, dairy ingredients and more, under well-known and established regional brands. Our fingerprints touch thousands of brands across the marketplace, and we're passionate about delivering the simple pleasures of dairy to people everywhere, straight from our family farm-owners. We are proud to provide families with fresh delicious dairy products.

By joining DFA, you can help us continue to make a difference that matters. We care deeply about the well-being of our neighbors and friends, and we celebrate the diversity of our company and our world. It takes an incredible team to deliver the goodness of dairy and enrich our communities – come join us!

**GENERAL PURPOSE**

Direct and coordinate overall plant operations and priorities, and through managers, supervisors, and staff, ensure product is produced efficiently and within cost parameters. Provide work direction to management and employees within the guidelines of standard work rules, union contract provisions (if applicable), and employment policies. Is held accountable for achieving the plant's key performance indicators. Support the Continuous Improvement (CI) initiative to improve productivity, quality, efficiency of operations, and the facility's culture. Manage the overall operating budget including capital and expense projects. Direct personnel activities of department, such as recruitment, hiring, performance evaluations, and salary adjustments using independent judgment within the framework of established human resources policies and practices.

This plant manager job is a single incumbent role responsible for multiple plants or a large and/or complex plant that may also have an assistant plant manager(s) within the plant.

**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Manage plant operations in all areas of responsibility including administration, production, processing, packaging, quality, maintenance, warehousing, shipping, purchasing, safety, and environmental

* Establish production priorities to ensure product is produced efficiently and within cost parameters while maintaining safety, quality and sanitation standards; obtain optimum production and utilization of workforce, machines, and equipment

* Review and analyze production, quality control, maintenance, and operational reports to ensure compliance and determine causes of non-conformity with product specifications, customer requirements, FDA/government regulations, etc. Report any non-compliance immediately per established protocol

* Analyze plant operations to ensure that the facility maintains a leadership position in the industry and that it takes advantage of new processes and technologies that become available

* Interact with customers to meet their expectations on a variety of goals including operational, customer service, financial, and quality

* Develop, monitor, and drive plant key performance indicators (KPI's) related to safety, quality, productivity and finances. Strive for continuous improvement in KPI results. Promote continuous improvement culture and activities

* Understand plant P&L to drive plant performance; participate in the development of annual operating, capital and expense budgets; provide reliable and accurate information to finance to meet end-of-month closing schedules

* Manage or oversee all corporate, customer, and government audits to ensure compliance

* Conduct meetings with management and staff to ensure all operational issues are being communicated and addressed expediently with a common understanding of goals

* Communicate company goals and assist in establishing objectives that align with plant and company goals; communicate plant direction, focus and goals

* Provide appropriate direction, mentoring, training, and development planning for managers. Identify and retain highly effective personnel through proper selection, training and task assignment. Actively work with direct reports to cultivate capabilities and utilize strengths to support career development and succession planning efforts

* Maintain safe working conditions for employees and compliance with all company, state and federal regulations regarding health and safety issues

* Follow all DFA good manufacturing practices (GMP) and work in a manner consistent with all company regulatory, food safety, quality, and sanitation requirements

* The requirements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employee, but is not a complete list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Other duties may be assigned as required

**BENEFITS:**

* Health and Welfare benefits begin 1st of the month after start date
* 401(k) with company contribution – 100% vested at day one of eligibility
* Competitive pay
* Paid vacation and holidays
* Career growth opportunities – we promote from within!
* Comprehensive healthcare benefits
* Service recognition and employee rewards
* Employee referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Work for dairy farm families

Requirements:

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* High school diploma or equivalent

* Undergraduate degree in related curriculum preferred

* 8 or more years' experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably dairy/ESL manufacturing

* 2 or more years' plant management experience

* Experience in union environments preferred

* Proven track record of improved results in the areas of quality, safety, service and cost

* Certification and/or License – may be required during course of employment

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**

* Strong knowledge of manufacturing process flow and importance to process

* Strong knowledge of continuous improvement models

* Thorough understanding of regulatory laws and responsibilities as it relates to facility standards

* Proficient understanding of budgeting and cost control

• Skill in leadership and coaching; strong knowledge of principles and practices of supervision, training, and personnel management • Knowledge of and skill with Microsoft Office Suite and company computer systems

* Skill in critical thinking, analysis, mathematical calculations, and statistical evaluations

* Able to work in collaboration effectively and foster good teamwork

* Able to interact positively and work effectively with others (interpersonal skills)

* Able to think and use independent judgment in planning and organizing multiple tasks and information

* Able to demonstrate strong initiative

* Able to take appropriate steps to find solutions to problems

* Able to present options and ideas to current processes or procedures

* Able to handle challenging or conflict situations with tact and professionalism

* Able to communicate with various levels of personnel to ensure customers' needs and requirements are met

* Able to interpret and apply company policies

* Able to adapt and manage to change effectively

* Must be able to read, write and speak English

An Equal Opportunity Employer including Disabled/Veterans

 
 
Compensation: $175000 - $190000 / year

new_roles.description:
**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

Eaton's Electrical Sector Americas - ARS/Fibrebond division is currently seeking a Plant Manager for its manufacturing operations in Minden, Louisiana. This role is a critical member of the site leadership team and is responsible for leading safe, high-quality, on-time, and cost-effective operations. Relocation assistance is available to candidates currently residing in the U.S. 
 
In this role, you will lead the Minden manufacturing site and its leadership team. You will drive strategic and operational initiatives including plant P&L, growth strategy, capacity, execution, and the direction of the team to meet and exceed short- and long-term business goals. You will foster an environment of engagement and inclusion for all employees and act with advocacy, empathy, and accountability. 
 
Fibrebond, an Eaton company, designs and manufactures pre-integrated modular buildings and power enclosures that protect mission-critical equipment for data center, industrial, utility, and communications customers. Headquartered in Minden, Louisiana, Fibrebond is known for its engineered-to-order solutions that support complex infrastructure projects across North America. In 2025, Fibrebond was acquired by Eaton, expanding Eaton's modular solutions portfolio while preserving Fibrebond's strong engineering expertise, customer focus, and manufacturing operations in Louisiana. 
 
**What you’ll need:** 

* Develop short- and long-term plans in alignment with the strategic plan and annual profit plan objectives to drive superior operational performance and financial results.
* Lead the operational management team and functional staff including Quality, OPEX, EHS and Supply Chain.
* Establish objectives and drive Key Performance Indicators across the organization ensuring continuous improvement.
* Emphasize utilization of Lean/Six Sigma manufacturing tools (Kaizen, VSM, 5S+) to lead cost improvement
* Establish and manage inventory to profit plan, driving improved and sustainable processes; execute the Supply Demand Planning (SIOP), drive ownership and collaboration across all stakeholder groups; generate forecasts that meet customer expectations.
* Champion a workplace focused on Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) to drive a zero-incident safety culture.
* Focus on Quality, early detection and escalations across the site to reduce cost, drive efficiency and ensure compliance.
* Create a culture of exceeding customer expectations, ensuring that the organization is highly responsive to customer needs.
* Demonstrate the ability to be innovative by developing and implementing creative solutions to complex problems, fostering a culture of innovation and continuously seeking opportunities for improvement.
* Partner with Human Resources to drive talent management, learning, communication, and development strategies.
* Champion and advocate for a winning plant culture aligned with the Eaton Culture Model

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Required Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited institution
* 10+ years of experience with progressive levels of accountability and responsibility in roles focused on manufacturing, supply chain, finance, OPEX and/or related support functions in a manufacturing environment.
* 5+ years of people-management experience
* Must be able to travel as business needs require.
* Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position.This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

 
**Preferred Qualifications:** 

* MBA from an accredited institution
* Previous experience leading a complex engineered-to-order manufacturing operation through growth, capacity expansion, operational transformation.
* Plant P&L leadership experience with strong business acumen.
* 3+ years of experience as a leader of leaders.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

* This role will be based at our Fibrebond manufacturing plant in Minden, LA.
* Relocation will be offered for this position.

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

At Eaton, we strive to provide compensation and benefits that attract, engage, and retain the best talent. This includes competitive pay and a variety of benefit programs for eligible employees. The expected annual salary range for this role is $182000 - $266000 a year. This role is also eligible for a variable incentive program. *Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.*

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws.

You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.

To request a disability-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1-800-836-6345 to discuss your specific need. Only accommodation requests will be accepted by this phone number.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Plant Manager – Furniture Manufacturing**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on, and results-driven **Plant Manager** to lead our furniture manufacturing operations. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced manufacturing leader to take ownership of plant performance, develop a strong leadership team, improve production processes, and make a direct impact on the success and growth of the facility.

The Plant Manager will oversee all aspects of plant operations, including production, safety, quality, scheduling, cost management, and employee development. This individual will provide leadership and oversight to department supervisors across the facility, ensuring all departments work together to achieve production, quality, safety, and operational goals.

The ideal candidate is a strong, people-focused leader with a solid manufacturing background who knows how to motivate teams, develop supervisors, improve processes, solve problems, and create a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, and quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Plant Operations & Production**

* Direct and oversee daily manufacturing operations to ensure production goals, quality standards, and delivery expectations are consistently met.
* Coordinate activities across departments to maximize productivity, efficiency, and workflow.
* Identify and implement process improvements to reduce waste, control labor costs, and increase operational efficiency.
* Develop and monitor production goals, performance metrics, and operational procedures.
* Oversee equipment needs, maintenance coordination, and resource planning to support production demands.

**Leadership & Employee Development**

* Provide overall leadership, direction, and oversight to department supervisors across all areas of the manufacturing plant.
* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors to ensure effective management of their respective departments and teams.
* Establish clear performance expectations, goals, and accountability for department supervisors.
* Monitor departmental performance and work with supervisors to address challenges, improve productivity, and achieve production goals.
* Oversee employee training and development initiatives to build a skilled, productive workforce.
* Promote teamwork, communication, and collaboration between departments to ensure smooth and efficient plant operations.
* Foster a positive work environment focused on employee engagement, accountability, safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

**Cost Management & Financial Performance**

* Develop and manage plant budgets while maintaining effective cost controls.
* Identify opportunities to reduce labor and production costs without sacrificing quality or safety.
* Implement and maintain production cost tracking systems to evaluate manufacturing performance.
* Monitor labor utilization, productivity, and operating expenses to support profitability.

**Safety & Quality**

* Promote a safe working environment and ensure employees follow established safety procedures.
* Maintain high standards for product quality and accuracy throughout the manufacturing process.
* Monitor production processes and implement improvements to reduce defects, waste, and product returns.
* Ensure the facility has the necessary supplies, equipment, and resources to maintain safe and efficient operations.

**Systems & Process Improvement**

* Work closely with office personnel to improve administrative processes, reporting systems, and documentation.
* Establish and maintain effective production records and reporting procedures.
* Stay current with manufacturing technology, equipment, and industry best practices.
* Support improvements to systems and processes that enhance product quality, operational efficiency, and customer service.
* Perform other duties as needed to support the success of plant operations.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Required Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing, production, scheduling, or operations experience.
* Minimum of 3 years of leadership or supervisory experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated ability to lead supervisors and teams, manage performance, and drive operational results.
* Strong problem-solving, organizational, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 5–7 years of manufacturing operations or production management experience.
* Previous Plant Manager, Operations Manager, Production Manager, or similar leadership experience.
* Experience in furniture manufacturing or a similar production environment.
* Experience managing multiple departments and supervising department leaders.
* Experience managing production costs, labor efficiency, budgets, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related field is a plus, but equivalent hands-on experience will be considered.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong leadership and team-building skills.
* Employee development and performance management.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong time management and organizational abilities.
* Manufacturing and operational knowledge.
* Results-oriented mindset.
* Problem-solving and continuous improvement.
* Attention to detail and accountability.

**What We Offer**

We value our employees and offer a benefits package designed to support their health, financial well-being, and work-life balance.

* Health Insurance available after 90 days.
* 401(k) retirement plan available after one year.
* Paid vacation.
* Additional company benefits.

**Work Environment & Physical Requirements**

This position operates in a furniture manufacturing facility. The work environment may include exposure to airborne particles, fumes, moving mechanical equipment, vibration, and elevated noise levels.

The position requires frequent standing, walking, reaching, and use of hands. Occasional sitting, climbing, balancing, bending, kneeling, crouching, and crawling may be required.

The ability to regularly lift or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift or move up to 25 pounds is required. Specific vision requirements include close, distance, color, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

North Greene Utilities is seeking a certified Level 3 Water Treatment Plant Manager to lead operations at our Level 3 water treatment production plant in Baileyton Tennessee. This is a key leadership role responsible for the full management of plant functions, regulatory compliance, and a small team of operators.

Position Overview

The Plant Manager oversees all day-to-day and long-term operations of NGU’s Level 3 water treatment plant. The position ensures continuous production of safe, high-quality water that meets or exceeds all Tennessee Department of Environment and Conservation (TDEC) and U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) standards and guidance. The manager supervises, mentors, and develops a team of three subordinates while maintaining efficient, safe, and compliant plant operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage all plant functions and treatment processes to meet TDEC and EPA regulatory requirements and policy guidance.• Supervise, mentor, and train three subordinates. Two subordinates are expected to achieve Level 1 certification by mid-2027.• Develop, implement, and manage shift schedules to ensure continuous, reliable plant coverage.• Ensure compliance with all federal and state safety regulations and NGU safety protocols.• Conduct lifecycle and operational management of treatment infrastructure, including maintenance planning and capital needs.• Participate in daily stand-up meetings with the NGU management team.• Assist with HR requirements for subordinates, including ensuring compliance with company policies.• Monitor the health and welfare of subordinates.• Conduct biannual performance counseling for subordinates.• Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability to evolving operational requirements and tasks as directed by the Operations Supervisor and General Manager.• Maintain accurate records, reporting, and documentation required for regulatory compliance and internal management.

Qualifications

* Current Tennessee Level 3 Water Treatment Operator certification (required).• Proven experience in water treatment plant operations, preferably in a leadership or supervisory role.• Strong knowledge of TDEC and EPA drinking water regulations, treatment processes, and compliance requirements.• Ability to supervise, train, and develop staff.• Valid driver’s license and ability to meet any additional job-related certifications or requirements (e.g., safety, drug and alcohol screening).• Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.• Commitment to safety, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement.

Compensation and Benefits

NGU offers very competitive wages, an IRA, health insurance, and dental coverage. Additional details on pay and benefits will be discussed with qualified candidates.
