new_roles.title: Senior Manager Factory Engineering
new_roles.description:
At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature's Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic-related diseases.

At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager, Factory Engineering position is responsible for managing the engineering activities relating to the factory and provide professional engineering and strategic technical leadership in the Factory, ensuring people health and safety, product safety and environment are never compromised. Strategic leader for engineering function, leveraging Nestle’s leadership principles in the following areas; capital execution, asset maintenance and utilities excellence, engineering compliance, and sustainability.

**JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define and propose the Factory Engineering team’s plans and objectives, and monitor their implementation in accordance with the Engineering Policy, Key Principles, and Key Engineering Activities outlined in the Nestlé Engineering Excellence (NEE) master document.
* Live Nestle leadership principles in all aspects of the role.
* Set the technical strategic vision for the factory, leveraging other functional leaders and cascade objectives to all leaders in engineering department, within factory cost targets.
* Develop and maintain technical competencies at the factory, including detailed action plans, accountability to progress, talent review, career and succession planning.
* Drive equipment reliability through implementing maintenance foundations in TPM.
* Build cooperation and collaboration with the production and other cross functional teams to build world class operation.
* Improve maintenance cost structure by improving technical skill sets and optimizing 3rd party spend.
* Implement Nestle capital process to drive excellence in capital execution.
* Proactively develop, maintain and execute the capital market business strategy (MBS) to align with the business needs.
* Drive factory master planning to facilitate long term strategies across the factory for example in Safety, Quality and Warehouse.
* Ensure full compliance with all governing bodies for utilities system relevant to the Modesto site. This is paramount and non-negotiable to have strong understanding in these utilities systems.
* Maintain reliability through implementing maintenance foundations and TPM methodology.
* Develop and maintain all skillset necessary for internal management of utilities systems.
* Drive and execute plant sustainability objectives in line with market targets.
* Drive world class water management in the factory.
* Drive reliability in all electrical components in the factory.
* Ensure full compliance with Nestle standards including calibration.
* Develop technical skills in maintenance to ensure electrical reliability.
* Drive Innovation/Renovation, initiating/coordinating implementation of new processes/technology with relevant Market, Product Technology Center, Corporate and Strategic Business Unit.
* Cascade objectives to all leaders in alignment with factory objectives, and implement the strategic technical OMP and factory master plan.
* Develop a detailed cost management plan for all aspects of engineering, including year-over-year improvements.
* Develop a detailed action plan for all aspects of technical execution.
* Implement Maintenance Foundations and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) practices.
* Leverage corporate resources and ensure compliance with Nestlé Market standards.

**EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s Degree (BA/BS) is required, preferably in Engineering, including Mechanical, Chemical, or Process. Experience would be considered in lieu of a degree.

**EXPERIENCE & SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

* At least 10 years of related work experience is highly preferred with at least 3+ years of leadership/management experience.
* Knowledge of food safety, regulatory requirements for food safety and hygienic engineering (OSH&R) preferred.
* Strong understanding of, or ability to learn, the full scope of role responsibilities, including financial analysis and key business drivers such as: Nestlé Standard Costing, Asset and Maintenance Management (AMM), CAPEX budgeting and preparation (CIAT), and Industrial Services/Energy Management (NEMT).
* Familiarity with TPM and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proficiency with AutoCAD, Visio, CDM, AMM, ESAT, CIAT, NEMT and similar technical tools/systems.
* Demonstrated technical and managerial capabilities with in depth knowledge of food processing plant operations, technologies, utilities, maintenance systems, and hygienic engineering requirements (OSH&R).
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to apply root cause analysis and technical creativity to resolve complex short and long term issues.
* Effective communication and networking skills, with the ability to perform under pressure and in ambiguous environments.
* Experience in Project Engineering/Management, including plant design and construction.

Salary: $160,000.00 to $185,000.00 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at https://www.nestlejobs.com/nestle-in-the-us-benefits

new_roles.description:

Office

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. 
 
DESCRIPTION: 
Join Thermo Fisher Scientific as a Senior Manager, Plant/Site and contribute to global science and healthcare. You'll oversee operations at advanced facilities, ensuring the delivery of high-quality products that help our customers make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. This leadership role involves advancing operational excellence through Lean manufacturing principles, managing cross-functional teams, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. 
 
As the site leader, you'll be responsible for developing and executing strategic plans, ensuring regulatory compliance, and maintaining strong customer relationships. You'll support our core values of Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement while cultivating a culture of safety, quality, and operational excellence. This role offers the opportunity to implement positive change, support team development, and contribute to scientific advances. 
 
REQUIREMENTS: 

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in operations leadership in sophisticated manufacturing environments
* Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering, Science, Business Management, or related field
* Strong track record implementing Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies
* Experience leading teams in FDA-regulated, cGMP, ISO 13485, or similar quality systems
* Demonstrated financial acumen in budget management and operational cost control
* Excellence in developing and executing strategic and annual operating plans
* Proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams in matrix organizations
* Strong project management skills with ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives
* Experience with quality systems, regulatory compliance, and audit management
* Expert knowledge of operational KPIs and data-driven process improvement
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills across all organizational levels

* Proficiency in leading change management initiatives

* Experience of working in a unionized environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Ability to travel up to 10-15% as required
* Experience maintaining safety programs and environmental compliance
* Excellent vendor and customer relationship management skills

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in Connecticut is $131,300.00–$205,000.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

new_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**About the Team:**

**The Dow Jones Customer Service (DJCS) mission is to provide great service for our customers and great experiences for our people.**

Our team has the privilege of delivering impactful experiences by helping our customers access the trusted news and business information published and produced by our marquee brands including, The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch, Dow Jones Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance. You will find that we are a collaborative group, focused on delivering excellence during every customer interaction. We encourage anyone that wants to join us in our mission to apply.

**About the Role:**

The Senior Manager, Training & Quality Assurance is responsible for new hire training, ongoing learning, knowledge management, and quality assurance across DJCS globally. You will report to the Vice President of Customer Support Operations and be based in our New Jersey office.

**You Will**

* Own and modernize curricula across DJCS, defining content, sequence, timing, delivery methods, and readiness standards to shorten time to proficiency and support development beyond initial onboarding. Coordinate Training-led modules and specialist instruction from hiring teams within the agreed plan.
* Lead the expansion of web-based, self-paced learning for onboarding and ongoing uptraining, combining it with live instruction, systems practice, and shadowing where appropriate.
* Improve knowledge accuracy, usability, adoption, and maintenance, and prepare the team, content, and working practices for AI-enabled tools.
* Lead the adoption and validation of automated quality management (AQM) across teams and contact types, establish standards for coaching and performance scoring, and redeploy human QA toward targeted investigation and improvement.
* Develop staff capabilities and close Consumer/B2B knowledge gaps through cross-training and shared responsibilities, identifying where tools or specialist support are needed.
* Manage training capacity and delivery, oversee curriculum standards and trainer quality across outsourcing partners, and extend product training and onboarding capability beyond DJCS.
* Partner with stakeholders to understand needs, agree priorities and delivery commitments, and communicate progress and tradeoffs. Measure both program results and stakeholder feedback to ensure the team delivers effective support and a reliable partnership.

**Who you Are**

* You set a clear direction, challenge established approaches, and turn ideas into practical improvements.
* You are resourceful and persistent, working through obstacles and balancing change with daily operational demands.
* You develop people and deliver through others, setting clear expectations, building skills, and getting into the details when needed.
* You build stakeholder trust through responsiveness, honest communication, and follow-through.
* You use data, employee and stakeholder feedback, and testing to set priorities, make decisions, and measure results.

**You Have**

* 7+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience managing a training or related performance improvement team in a contact center environment, including developing staff capabilities.
* Demonstrated success leading changes to onboarding or ongoing learning, with measurable improvements in proficiency, productivity, and learning effectiveness.
* Experience leading blended learning development and delivery, including self-paced digital content, through internal teams or external specialists.
* Experience using quality evaluation or interaction analytics to identify performance gaps and measure the results of improvement initiatives.
* Experience delivering cross-functional initiatives against agreed commitments, supported by examples of effective stakeholder partnerships.
* Ability to travel up to 20%, both domestically and internationally.
* Experience implementing or expanding AQM (preferred).
* Experience managing knowledge resources or implementing AI-enabled learning, knowledge, or employee-support tools (preferred).
* Experience selecting or managing learning technology, external specialists, or outsourced training and QA programs (preferred).

**Our Benefits**

* Comprehensive Healthcare Plans
* Paid Time Off
* Retirement Plans
* Comprehensive Insurance Plans
* Education Benefits
* Family Care Benefits
* Commuter Transit Program
* Subscription Discounts
* Employee Referral Program

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance Ops Excellence and Resiliency
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary...**
-----------------------

We’re looking for a Senior Manager of Ops Excellence and Resiliency to build and lead the process improvement, operational resilience, and AI transformation capabilities for Last Mile Delivery (LMD) Risk Operations. This role will turn findings and opportunities identified through Monitoring & Assurance, Risk Intelligence, incidents, and operational performance into redesigned workflows, stronger operating models, and scalable transformation roadmaps. The Senior Manager will bring a TPM/process driven mindset to simplify and standardize how work gets done, identify critical dependencies and failure points, strengthen contingency and readiness practices, and develop an AI transformation roadmap that rethinks how Risk Operations can operate—not simply make today’s manual steps faster. The role will partner across Risk Operations and with Product, Technology, Analytics, and other stakeholders to move validated opportunities from insight to sustainable operational change.

**What you'll do...**
---------------------

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build the Ops Excellence and Resiliency capability for Risk Operations, creating an integrated approach to process improvement, operational resilience, and technology-enabled transformation.
* Translate findings from Monitoring & Assurance, Risk Intelligence, root cause analysis, incidents, and operational performance into a prioritized portfolio of process, resilience, automation, and AI transformation opportunities.
* Lead end-to-end process redesign by applying a TPM/process driven mindset to simplify, standardize, and optimize Risk Operations workflows, reducing unnecessary manual work, inefficient handoffs, failure points, and unclear ownership.
* Build an operational resilience model by identifying critical processes, dependencies, single points of failure, technology and data vulnerabilities, and contingency needs across Risk Operations.
* Develop dependency maps, contingency playbooks, and operational readiness practices in partnership with process owners to help critical incident and safety response capabilities continue through disruption.
* Develop and maintain the AI transformation roadmap for Risk Operations, identifying where AI can reshape intake, investigations, monitoring, analysis, decision support, reporting, and other workflows rather than simply automate individual manual steps.
* Evaluate and prioritize AI and automation opportunities based on operational value, feasibility, risk, scalability, and alignment to business needs, and translate validated opportunities into pilots and delivery roadmaps with Product and Technology partners.
* Partner with Incident Management, Safety, Monitoring & Assurance, Risk Intelligence, Product, Technology, Analytics, Legal, Compliance, and other stakeholders to redesign workflows and implement sustainable improvements across organizational boundaries.
* Establish measures of success for transformation and resilience efforts, including cycle-time reduction, handoffs eliminated, process consistency, adoption, resilience readiness, recovery performance, and realized benefits from automation and AI-enabled changes.
* Create clear executive reporting and recommendations that show the improvement portfolio, resilience risks and readiness, AI transformation opportunities, implementation progress, dependencies, decisions required, and measurable outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in operational excellence, process engineering, continuous improvement, operational resilience, business continuity, technology transformation, program management, risk operations, or related fields.
* 3+ years leading teams or complex cross-functional initiatives in high-volume or operationally complex environments.
* Demonstrated experience redesigning and simplifying end-to-end operational processes, with the ability to translate findings and pain points into scalable future-state workflows.
* Strong process engineering and structured problem-solving capabilities, with experience identifying root causes, dependencies, failure points, and opportunities to reduce manual work and inefficient handoffs.
* Experience building or supporting operational resilience, business continuity, contingency planning, dependency mapping, or operational readiness programs.
* Experience developing and executing transformation roadmaps involving technology, automation, analytics, or AI-enabled operations, including the ability to distinguish incremental automation from broader operating-model transformation.
* Strong data-driven decision-making skills with the ability to synthesize monitoring findings, risk intelligence, operational metrics, and stakeholder input into prioritized improvement opportunities and measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication, program leadership, and influencing skills, with the ability to partner across Product, Technology, Analytics, Risk Operations, and other cross-functional teams to move ideas from identification through implementation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in last-mile delivery, gig economy platforms, marketplaces, trust & safety, transportation, retail, e-commerce, investigations, fraud/risk operations, or other high-volume decision environments.
* Familiarity with TPM, Lean/Six Sigma, process engineering, systems thinking, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience designing business continuity or operational resilience frameworks, including dependency mapping, contingency playbooks, readiness exercises, or recovery planning.
* Experience identifying, evaluating, and implementing AI and automation opportunities within complex operational workflows, including development of opportunity roadmaps, pilots, or business cases.
* Experience partnering with monitoring, assurance, risk intelligence, product, engineering, and analytics teams to convert operational findings and emerging risks into sustainable process and technology improvements. 
 
 At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Paid time off benefits include PTO (including sick leave), parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. Other benefits include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more.

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We’re hiring a Senior Manager Quality Control (QC) Lab Operations to support our teams at our new highly automated drug substance manufacturing facility. The Senior Manager, QC Lab Operations leads a team who supports the technical and operational lifecycle of assigned QC laboratories, including new lab builds, fit-outs, relocations; new technology implementation; and continuous capability upgrades. The role sets strategy for lab operations, accounting for testing demand, equipment utilization, capacity, sample and data flow, and staffing. They partner with internal partners to resolve cross-functional conflicts and schedule, resource, and compliance risks. The role ensures changes meet FDA cGMP requirements and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. Represents the team during regulatory inspections and internal audits. Oversees hiring, training, performance management, and development of team members while standardizing lab implementation practices across sites.

**When & where:**

* Location: Rensselaer, New York, United States
* Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm
* Travel: 50% domestic- mostly capital region

**SENIOR MANAGER, QUALITY IMPROVEMENT**

**What you’ll do.**

As the Senior Manager, Quality Improvement, you’ll help neurologists put evidence into practice by managing the processes that support clinical practice guidelines, evidence-based publications, and resources. You’ll advance the AAN’s strategic objectives by supporting the development of timely, evidence-based clinical guidelines, editorial and dissemination strategies, and meaningful resources that engage neurologists in improving their practice. Working across divisions, you’ll connect clinical practice and quality efforts to deliver value for AAN members.

**Please review the attached job description for full details. If viewing from an external site, please visit** **https://www.aan.com/about-the-aan/work-at-the-aan****.**

**Who we are.**

Join a diverse community of fun, energetic, and dedicated employees and members who are committed to supporting neurologists worldwide in providing exceptional care to their patients. The AAN's vision is to be indispensable to our members, and we continue to embrace our values of Community, Leadership, Well-being and Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Together, we pursue our mission to enhance member career fulfillment and promote brain health for all.

The AAN, founded in Minneapolis in 1948, supports and represents more than 44,000 neurologists and neuroscience professionals worldwide who provide crucial patient care, seek new cures and treatments for brain disease and work to ensure patient access to the right care. Our headquarters is in a stunning, energy-efficient office, located in downtown Minneapolis’s dynamic Mill District, and our public policy office is near the action on Capitol Hill in Washington, DC. Both locations offer easy access to light rail, major bus lines, parking options, walking/biking paths, and a myriad of dining and entertainment choices, making it a vibrant hub for everyone.

**What we look for.**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Public Health, Health Care Management, Health Sciences, Nursing, or related field

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 5 years of related experience in healthcare management and quality improvement
* Minimum of 3 years of supervisory experience
* Minimum of 3 years of project management experience
* Demonstrated ability to uphold the AAN’s values
* Demonstrated ability to supervise a team in a fast-paced environment and nurture individual career development and growth
* Ability to provide clear instructions and successful presentations to staff, work groups and panels
* Demonstrated skill, tact, diplomacy, confidentiality, and professionalism in interactions with teams, members, and other relevant individuals or groups
* Demonstrated proficiency using MS Office for word, spreadsheet, and presentations
* Excellent time management skills, ability to deliver results when facing multiple projects with tight deadlines
* Advanced knowledge of evidence-based medicine and clinical practice guideline development is preferred
* Knowledge of established evidence grading, and recommendation-development methods, such as GRADE or comparable frameworks is preferred
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and physician or subject-matter expert panels through complex evidence-based projects is preferred
* Demonstrated experience providing strategic and operational leadership for multiple concurrent, multi-year programs or projects is preferred
* Experience identifying and implementing process improvements, technology, or emerging approaches is preferred

*Relevant education and/or experience exceeding the required qualifications may be substituted on a year-for-year basis.*

**Travel Requirements:** Minimal travel required – up to 5%

**Location:** Minneapolis, MN and is identified as hybrid (required to work in the office with the ability to work remotely part of the week)

**Schedule:** Occasional evening and weekends required

 + Comprehensive wellness programs
 + Paid parental, family, and bereavement leave

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Performance and Quality
new_roles.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

As the Senior Manager, Performance and Quality, you'll lead proposal development and formal client responses for the account, and coordinate the team's responses to client, external, and government audits. You'll turn complex contract, pricing, performance guarantee, and operational requirements into accurate, persuasive, on-time submissions. Every commitment and audit response you produce is supported, traceable, and clear to the client. In Finance and Contract Compliance, you'll link what proposals promise to how performance and quality are checked through audits and corrective action. You will also project-manage implementations and changes on the account.

**Primary responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Develop proposal strategies and response plans for renewals, RFPs, RFIs, client-requested program and benefit-change proposals, and contract amendments that align with account objectives and client requirements.
* Manage the end-to-end development and submission of proposals and formal client responses, from requirement intake through final review and delivery.
* Partner with account, executive, Finance, Legal, Clinical, and Operations leadership to define key messages and value propositions, and confirm that pricing, performance guarantee, and contract commitments are accurate and approved before submission.
* Write clear, persuasive, client-ready narratives and executive communications about capabilities, program results, and positions, and represent the team in client meetings on proposals and deliverables.
* Lead project management for implementations and account changes, such as new programs, vendor transitions, and benefit or system changes. Build and manage project plans for these and for RFPs, renewals, contract amendments, client deliverables, and audit responses, with timelines, milestones, owners, and dependencies. Plan for compressed client turnaround times and escalate at-risk items early.
* Research client needs, program developments, and market and competitive trends to inform proposal strategy and client recommendations.
* Implement standardized templates, content libraries, style guides, and quality checklists for proposals and audit responses, and train contributors to use them.
* Support contract negotiations during RFPs and amendments by coordinating redlines and negotiating items with Legal and leadership, and documenting each decision to keep, trade, or drop an item, with its approver, so the rationale stays on record.
* Own the audit request log and coordinate intake, scoping, ownership, and evidence production for client, external, and government audits of the account, including third-party audits triggered by performance guarantee escalation provisions.
* Perform quality reviews of audit responses and evidence packages to confirm every part of the request is addressed, amounts reconcile, and the response is clear to an independent reviewer; coordinate secure submission and retain final versions.
* Maintain internal corrective action plans (CAPs) for known contract breaches, so completed fixes are documented before the client asks, and lead the response when the client invokes the contract's formal CAP process. Track audit findings, management responses, fixes, and closeout against contract timelines, and report recurring performance and quality themes to leadership.

**Key deliverables**
--------------------

* Proposal and client-response calendar, plus a project plan for each RFP, renewal, contract amendment, implementation, and major account change.
* Proposal strategies and response plans for renewals, RFPs, RFIs, and client-requested proposals.
* Standard content library, templates, style guide, and quality checklist.
* Commitment and negotiating-items log tying each commitment and redline decision to its approver and source.
* Audit request log, scope and ownership matrix, and evidence-package standards.
* Internal CAP register for known contract breaches, plus a findings, management-response, and corrective-action tracker and audit closeout packages.
* Leadership summaries of open proposals, implementation and change status, at-risk deliverables, and audit status.

***\*\*\*This is a remote role, but the ideal candidate will live in the Eastern Time Zone\*\*\****

**Minimum qualifications**

* 7+ years of work experience.
* Experience managing end-to-end proposal or RFP responses for complex healthcare or PBM clients.
* Experience planning, executing, and delivering across concurrent deadlines and owners.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and proposal content-management tools.

**Preferred qualifications**

* PBM, health plan, or government program experience, including implementations or vendor transitions.
* Experience coordinating audits, regulatory requests, or evidence-based client reviews.
* Experience validating pricing, performance guarantee, or contract commitments in proposals.
* Proposal management or project management certification.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$67,900.00 - $182,549.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

 
This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

 
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 11/14/2026

Who is Swire Coca-Cola? We are a family-owned bottling company with a story spanning over two centuries. We are one of the largest bottlers of Coca-Cola in North America and distribute more than 50 beverage brands and flavors creating joy for our customers every day. Our 8,000+ driven employees work hard as part of a team that delivers refreshment to over 30 million consumers across 13 states. Begin a journey with us at Swire Coca-Cola and belong to a community of dedicated team members who think big and believe in winning together.
 
 
**Job Details:** 
**Job Level:** 7
 
 
**Why you’ll love working at Swire Coca-Cola:** 
Swire Coca-Cola is committed to providing balance to support you in all aspects of your life, both at work and beyond. We offer the benefits you need for physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
 
 

* Health coverage (3 medical options, dental and vision). 401(k) Retirement Plan w/company match
* Health Savings Accounts w/company match
* FREE virtual primary care, acute care and physical therapy
* FREE Employee Assistance Program
* Company paid (vacation, holidays, sick time, bereavement, jury duty, maternity/parental, disability leave and volunteer time)
* Discounted & free product
* Tuition reimbursement
* Opportunities for career advancement

In addition to health benefits, Swire Coca-Cola is proud to offer you opportunities where you help give back directly to the communities and causes you care about. Note: Enrollment in a Swire Medical Plan is required for some benefits.
 
 
What does a Sr. Quality Manager do at Swire Coca-Cola?
 
Lead the Manufacturing Quality discipline at a manufacturing plant level to ensure that plant is operating to the Coca-Cola KORE standards and that all products produced maintain the highest standards of consumer quality for brand integrity.
 
 
**Responsibilities:** 

* Develop, guide and measure the in-plant quality standards that must be met to manufacture products that meet all KO and industry standards for consumer consumption
* Hire, train, and mentor Quality Lab Technicians and Lab/Sanitation Supervisors at the plant level to ensure they are qualified to perform all the quality processes and procedures required to deliver quality product to consumers
* Guide the creation and maintenance of documentation, processes, and procedures to fully comply with all KO KORE standards requirements, as well as any other industry/regulatory requirements for quality in manufacturing at the plant level
* Establish and maintain strong associations with other Coca-Cola bottlers in the Quality Management space in order to effectively learn best practices, provide guidance/counsel where appropriate, and be aware of changing trends and requirements that must be implemented at the plants
* Proactively develop relationships with local and state government agencies responsible for managing water usage and quality standards, discharge standards, etc
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Requirements:** 

* High School Diploma (or GED) required and
* College degree preferred in chemistry, biology, preferred or related science field
* 4+ years' experience in Quality Management in a food manufacturing industry – soft drink preferred
* Strong understanding of the science of soft drink production at the base molecular level
* Strong knowledge of industry quality standards for manufacturing of food grade products
* Specific knowledge of all state and local standards and requirements for water quality and raw materials for food grade production
* KO KORE and ISO quality standards in a soft drink environment

Come and join our Sparkling team!

Screening results are evaluated based on several factors, including the nature and severity of an offense, how much time has passed, the relevance to the position, patterns of repeated offenses, and driving history for roles that require operating a vehicle.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Flight Line Quality Control
new_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**Summary of Position****:**

The Senior Quality Manager of Flight Line Quality Control Management, and Execution of Helicopter Flight Line of an FAA part 21 approved Quality System. The Senior Manager, Quality Control of Flight Line will ensure compliance and safety, balanced with cost in alignment with operations to safely bring aircraft to pre-flight, ground test, and flight testing. Driving the finalization process to the delivery and acceptance intent on ZERO defect aircraft being presented to customers. Provide technical leadership, leaning on knowledge of FAA P21 requirements, AS9100, and aerospace knowledge. The Senior Quality Manager of Flight Line, will also focus on personnel management and development, ensuring competencies equal to the business and market requirements. The Senior Manager will have a Continuous Improvement approach to processes while executing to the business plan.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities****:**

* Safe and on time actions bringing Production Helicopters to Operation, Ground Run, Flights, Acceptance & Delivery to Customer
* Resource Management, deployment of resources, training and building out Competencies of resources to meet customer and market demand
* Ensure compliance of Quality System with all relevant, FAA guidelines, procedures and policies.
* Represents QC as the prime contact for customer delivery activities
* Proactive measures in the planning and execution of aircraft operations, customer Acceptance and Delivery activity
* Continuous Improvement: using methods like DMAIC, statistical analysis to understand and improve processes and contributing to the efficiency of the Flight Line Operation

**Qualifications for Position****:**

**A. Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aviation Management, or a related technical discipline

**B. Experience**

* 5+ years of management and Quality experience or Equivalent

**C. Competencies & Attributes**

The successful candidate will have a working knowledge of AS9100 QMS and FAA requirements. Experience in Lean/Six Sigma, and a demonstrated approach to the job is a must. new_roles.description:
**Join Our Team!**

Sunbelt Rentals strives to be the customer's first choice in the equipment rental industry. From pumps to scaffolding to general construction tools, we aim to be the only call needed to outfit a job site with the proper equipment. Not only do we offer a vast fleet that ranks among the best in the industry, we pair it all with a friendly and knowledgeable staff. Our employees are our greatest asset, and although we present a comprehensive equipment offering, our expertise and service are what truly distinguish us from the competition.

We pride ourselves on investing in our workforce and offer competitive benefits, as well as extensive on-the-job training for all eligible employees.

As a highly successful national company, we are constantly looking for talented individuals to support our growth. If you are interested in pursuing a rewarding career, we invite you to review our opportunities!

**Job Description Summary**

Position Objective: 
The General Manager, Manufacturing oversees all aspects of manufacturing processes to ensure proven product functionality with a sustainable return on investment (ROI). The General Manager Manufacturing manages subordinate staff and coordinates with remote departments that are responsible for engineering development and manufacturing engineering. This candidate must have proven supervisory and technical skills, and an appreciation for the complex nature of the rental HVAC industry. Personal skills that will be required include exceptional business foresight, superlative communication skills, working knowledge of several engineering disciplines and how they relate to one another, and an aptitude for managing risk.

Position Responsibilities: 

* Develops and promotes a “Zero Harm Safety Culture” leveraging Sunbelt’s Engage for Life Safety programs, fine tuning safety policy as it relates to manufacturing operations
* Has overall financial responsibility of local manufacturing operation, inventory, budgeting, cost controls, capital equipment acquisition and manufacturing facilities
* In partnership with senior management, develops and implements manufacturing plans support growth, safety and manufacturing efficiencies
* Develops the manufacturing management team, inspiring leadership through empowerment, coaching and accountability
* Develops manufacturing forecast and roughcut capacity plans
* Communicates with fleet planning, coordinating changing priorities and product deliveries
* Utilizes proven continuous improvement strategies to refine manufacturing processes and products, that minimize scrap, reduce rework & line failures and has emphasis on building the highest quality equipment at the lowest costs
* Establishes, implements, and maintains administrative policies, procedures, and standards
* Ensures production facility adheres to all local, national laws, including labor and environmental
* Develops long-term strategic initiatives for manufacturing operations
* Maintains knowledge of new trends, developments, technologies, materials, and best practices; applies this knowledge to continually improve product lines and production efficiency

Requirements: 
Education & Experience: 

* Degree in Business Administration or a related field
* 5+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operation (metal fabrication & production assembly environments experience preferred)
* Possesses knowledge and understanding of manufacturing processes and systems, engineering systems, and product inventory management, manufacturing accounting and ERP systems
* Analytical and mathematical mind, capable of evaluating and solving various complex problems
* Leadership skills necessary to manage several experienced and driven teams, including proven supervisory and technical skills
* Self-motivated attitude with the ability to multitask and thrive in a timeline-driven environment
* Interpersonal communication skills with expertise in distilling complicated topics to a broader

Base Pay Range: $108,430.00 - 149,091.80

Starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. Please visit https://www.sunbeltrentals.com/careers/ for more information on our benefits and to join our Talent Network. 
 
Sunbelt also provides a comprehensive benefits package to its full-time employees. This package includes:

* Health, Dental and Vision plans
* 401(k) Match
* Volunteer time off
* Short-term and long-term disability
* Accident, Life and Travel insurance, as well as flexible spending
* Tuition Reimbursement Options
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Length of Service Awards

You will become eligible for benefits on the first of the month following 30 days from your start date. Sunbelt offers team members the following paid time off from work, subject to Sunbelt’s policies (unless specified in a collective bargaining agreement):

* 12-25 vacation days depending on years of service
* 5 sick days
* 6 holidays
* 2 half day holidays
* 2 floating holidays
* 1 inclusion day
* 1 volunteer day

Gear up for an exciting career! 
 
Sunbelt Rentals supports service members. Veterans encouraged to apply.

new_roles.title: Manufacturing Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
The Plant Manager oversees the daily operations of the manufacturing facility. This role involves managing production activities, ensuring adherence to quality standards, maintaining a safe work environment, and optimizing processes for efficiency and cost-effectiveness. The Plant Manager will lead a team of supervisors and operators to meet production goals while upholding the company’s standards for safety and quality.

Roles and Responsibilities:

· Lead cultural transformation initiatives that align behaviors, mindsets, and daily actions with the company's values in safety, quality, service, and continuous improvement

* Plan, organize, and oversee the manufacturing process to ensure production targets are met.
* Develop and manage the plant’s budget, including labor, materials, and overhead costs.
* Develop and execute strategies to enhance employee engagement, recognition, and retention.
* Foster a service-oriented mindset across the plant, ensuring all employees understand their role in meeting and exceeding internal and external customer expectations.
* Build a culture where continuous improvement is part of everyday problem-solving at all levels.
* Empower employees to identify, test, and implement improvement ideas.
* Regularly communicate the vision, progress, and achievement of the cultural transformation to inspire and motivate teams.
* Implement lean manufacturing practices to improve efficiency and reduce waste.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of supervisors, operators, and other plant personnel.
* Prepare reports on production performance, costs, and other key metrics for senior management.

Competencies:

* Strong leadership abilities with a proven track record of motivating and managing teams effectively.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to interact with all levels of the organization.
* Knowledge of quality control principles, methodologies, and industry-specific standards (e.g., ISO, Six Sigma).
* Proficiency in lean manufacturing techniques, continuous improvement processes, and waste reduction strategies.
* Strong understanding of workplace safety regulations, OSHA standards, and safety management practices.
* Accountable for execution of Safety, People, Quality, Delivery, and Cost-driving escalation to ensure customer service for internal and external customers.
* Execute all responsibilities according to lawful and ethical standards as established by company policies and procedures.

Experience and Education:

* Bachelor’s Degree: Preferably in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Management, Mechanical Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field or a minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a manufacturing environment in similar role
* **Experience in manufacturing plant management with focus on Manufacturing and Quality resource accountability min 5 yrs**
* Bilingual highly preferred
* Familiarity with manufacturing software systems and data analysis tools. Competence in using software for planning, scheduling, and reporting.

Pay: $140,000.00 - $155,000.00 per year

* 401(k)

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Operations
new_roles.description:
Since 2018, Elevate Aircraft Seating has been enhancing the passenger experience through innovative aircraft seat design and manufacturing. With locations in California, Washington, and Germany we are guided by creativity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to quality.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Manager Operations to join our team in Santa Maria, CA. This is an on-site position based in Santa Maria, CA. We value teamwork, inclusivity, and continuous professional development, and we offer competitive benefits along with opportunities for growth.

**Export Control Requirements:**

**This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager, Operations is responsible for leading and overseeing manufacturing operations and maintenance activities to ensure the achievement of safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost objectives. This role drives operational performance through effective resource planning, workforce development, and process optimization while supporting continuous improvement initiatives. Partnering cross-functionally, the Senior Manager implements operational strategies, promotes accountability, and ensures efficient manufacturing execution aligned with organizational and customer objectives.

**SUMMARY OF JOB DUTIES** - **Essential Functions****(Other duties and projects may be assigned or requested.)**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions*

**Operational Leadership & Performance**

* Lead and oversee daily manufacturing operations and maintenance activities to achieve safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, labor efficiency, scrap reduction, and work-in-process (WIP) inventory objectives.
* Establish, monitor, and drive accountability for key operational performance indicators (KPIs), implementing corrective actions to address performance gaps.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying operational inefficiencies, collaborating with relevant stakeholders, and implementing improvements within manufacturing operations.

**Production Planning & Execution**

* Oversee all phases of manufacturing operations to ensure production activities comply with established procedures, quality standards, and approved manufacturing processes.
* Plan, coordinate, and optimize departmental activities, production schedules, and resource allocation to meet customer requirements and business objectives.
* Evaluate production capacity, workforce requirements, and operational constraints to ensure effective utilization of labor, equipment, and manufacturing resources.

**People Leadership & Workforce Development**

* Lead, develop, and manage production and associated functional teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and operational excellence.
* Oversee workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, training, and employee development to maintain operational readiness.
* Establish performance expectations, evaluate employee performance, and partner with Human Resources on coaching, employee relations, corrective actions, and performance management.

**Quality, Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure manufacturing operations adhere to established Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, AS9100 standards, applicable aerospace regulations, and internal policies and procedures.
* Promote a culture of safety, quality, and compliance by ensuring employees are appropriately trained and consistently follow established manufacturing procedures.

**Financial Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Manage departmental budgets, monitor operational expenditures, and implement cost-control measures to support financial objectives.
* Partner with Supply Chain, Planning, Quality, Engineering, Program Management, and other stakeholders to resolve operational challenges, align production priorities, and meet customer delivery commitments.

**Other**

* Maintain a safe, secure and legal work environment, adhering to all Company policies and procedures.
* Protect the confidentiality of the Company’s information and products.
* Contribute to team efforts by performing other job-related duties and projects as assigned or requested.

**GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS – Education, Knowledge, and Experience**

**Education**:

* High School Diploma or GED equivalent required.
* Associate degree, technical/trade certification, or bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

**Experience**:

* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations, including 5+ years in a leadership role overseeing production teams, operational performance, and manufacturing processes.
* Demonstrated success managing manufacturing operations in a complex, quality-driven production environment, with a focus on improving safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost performance.
* Proven ability to lead supervisors or managers, develop high-performing teams, and drive operational improvements across multiple manufacturing functions.

**Skills**:

* Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to develop teams, establish accountability, and manage employee performance.
* Proficiency in manufacturing operations, production planning, workforce allocation, and capacity management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret operational KPIs and implement effective corrective actions.
* Knowledge of budget management, cost control, and resource optimization within a manufacturing environment.
* Effective communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and support business objectives.

**Preferred Skills/Experience:**

* Experience in aerospace manufacturing, aircraft interiors, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments, with knowledge of AS9100 and Quality Management Systems (QMS).
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience utilizing Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and manufacturing performance reporting tools.

**Other**:

* Extended or irregular hours may be required.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.
* Elevate Aircraft Seating is an “at-will” employer; employment is at the mutual consent of both the employee and the employer, and may be terminated at will for any reason, with or without cause, at any time during employment with the Company.
* As business conditions warrant a change in the operating necessities of the Company, all employees are expected to react productively, handle other essential tasks assigned now or in the future.
* Tasks may vary slightly based on products produced at a division.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**CERTIFICATES AND LICENSE**

* N/A

**SUPERVISION PROVIDED TO THE POSITION**

* Direction is provided for assignments in terms of desired outcome (goals), timing and budget.? Work is reviewed or measured in terms of meeting organizational objectives and schedules.

**LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITY**

* Provides leadership, coaching, and direction to operational personnel to achieve organizational goals, operational performance objectives, and budgetary targets. Responsible for employee development, performance management, and building organizational capability.

**PROBLEM SOLVING**

* Develop and implement solutions to complex operational challenges that are consistent with organizational objectives and established business practices.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS** 
*Elevate Aircraft Seating offers competitive wages and benefits to recognize employees for their work. The base pay offered will vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, location, experience and take into account internal equity.*

**Salary Range Transparency:** $125,500 - $185,000

**Featured Benefits:**

* Generous 401(K) matching with immediate eligibility and vesting
* 3 weeks of Paid Time Off
* 12 paid holidays
* Affordable health care plans for yourself and your family
* And so much more!

**Other Perks:**

* Supportive workplace environment with a team-oriented culture
* Potential for growth within organization

new_roles.title: Plant Manager- tissue and paper manufacturing
new_roles.description:
This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for a proven manufacturing executive with deep **paper manufacturing and paper machine operations experience**. Our client is seeking a hands-on, results-driven leader who can take full ownership of plant performance, strengthen operational discipline, and lead the facility to improved results across **safety, quality, production, reliability, cost and people development**.

The successful candidate will be responsible for all aspects of plant operations and will play a key role in driving performance improvements, stabilizing underperforming areas, and building a strong culture of accountability, teamwork and continuous improvement.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This role is ideal for a seasoned Plant Manager or senior operations leader who understands the complexity of paper manufacturing and has a track record of improving plant performance through strong leadership, technical knowledge, disciplined execution and data-driven decision-making.

The Plant Manager will oversee the day-to-day and strategic leadership of the facility, ensuring the plant operates safely, efficiently and profitably while developing both leadership and frontline teams.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead all plant operations to achieve established **safety, quality, production, reliability and financial objectives**.
* Build and reinforce a strong **safety culture** through visible leadership, clear expectations, coaching and accountability at all levels of the organization.
* Oversee plant performance and ensure operations are aligned with productivity, quality and cost targets.
* Optimize **paper machine performance**, equipment uptime, production output and finished-product quality.
* Improve equipment reliability through strong maintenance systems, including preventive and predictive maintenance, planning and scheduling, and root cause analysis.
* Manage and improve plant financial performance, including cost-per-ton, labour, maintenance, fibre, chemical and energy costs.
* Lead continuous improvement efforts using structured, data-driven problem-solving methodologies to improve operational and financial results.
* Develop and execute recovery or turnaround plans for underperforming operations, establishing clear priorities, ownership, milestones and measurable outcomes.
* Build, coach and strengthen plant leadership, technical and hourly teams through employee development, performance management, succession planning and accountability.
* Partner with maintenance, production, quality and leadership teams to ensure cross-functional alignment and effective execution of plant priorities.
* Establish a culture focused on **performance, engagement, ownership and continuous improvement**.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a strong plant leader with deep technical and operational knowledge of **paper manufacturing**, particularly **paper machine operations**, who can lead a large team and drive measurable business results.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing** or a related field is preferred.
* 10–15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* **Must have direct paper manufacturing experience**, including demonstrated technical knowledge of **paper machine operations**.
* Proven experience leading paper machine operations and delivering sustainable improvements in performance, reliability and quality.
* Demonstrated success improving underperforming facilities or leading plant turnaround/recovery initiatives.
* Strong understanding of **papermaking processes, maintenance and reliability systems, plant operations and financial management**.
* Experience managing key manufacturing metrics, including productivity, equipment uptime, cost control and quality performance.
* Proven ability to lead large teams, develop talent, drive accountability and guide organizational change effectively.
* Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence performance at all levels of the plant.

Pay: $150,000.00 - $180,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Enter your email
* Available time for call

* tissue and paper manufacturing operation: 10 years (Required)

new_roles.title: Global Head of Deal Strategy and Operations
new_roles.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

**About Us**

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. 
 
Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. 
 
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

 

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. 
 
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Global Head of Deal Strategy and Operations to lead the worldwide deal function for a rapidly scaling data and analytics business formed by the combination of Fivetran and dbt Labs. This is a commercial strategy role as much as an operational one with a mandate to make our deals bigger, better, and faster. The leader owns the deal structures, pricing inputs, policies, and governance that drive more revenue and higher ASP, cleaner and lower-risk terms, and real velocity across every region and segment, while de-risking the business.

This is a pivotal role at a pivotal moment. The business is integrating two commercial engines, two product portfolios, and two sets of systems into a single combined go-to-market. The role sets the strategy for how deals get structured, priced, routed, reviewed, and approved, and acts as a key commercial advisor to GTM leadership on the structures that drive growth, including ELA and commercial strategy, cross-sell, and new product launches. It leads a global team across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC and partners closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Product, Systems, Pricing, and Partner Marketplace to keep decisions fast, consistent, and scalable.

This leader is an equal part strategist, operator, and trusted business partner. The ideal candidate moves fluidly between long-term commercial strategy and hands-on problem solving, has a proven track record scaling a deal function in a global, complex, high-growth SaaS environment, and leads teams through change with clarity and conviction.

Reports to the SVP, Strategy and Operations. This is a full-time, hybrid role based in one of our hub offices: New York, NY; Denver, CO; Oakland, CA; or Austin, TX.

**What You'll Do**

* *Team leadership and organizational development*
 + Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing global Deal Desk organization.
 + Coach the team to operate as commercial advisors to the field, raising the strategic value of every interaction with Sales.
 + Build capability and bench strength, reducing key-person dependency as the team scales.
* *Strategic leadership and vision*
 + Own and execute the global vision for the Deal Desk organization across the combined Fivetran + dbt business.
 + Conceptualize and launch new, high-impact commercial strategies and deal constructs (e.g. multi-year deals, shift to consumption-based pricing, and product-specific ELAs) that grow revenue and move the business forward.
 + Lead commercial strategy for the Fivetran + dbt integration, landing one combined operating model, policy set, and deal construct.
 + Build the team structure, governance framework, and ways of working needed to support a global enterprise sales engine selling a multi-product, consumption-based portfolio.
 + Position the deal function as a driver of growth, net revenue retention, and cross-sell, and align the C-suite behind that mandate.
* *Commercial guidance and executive escalation*
 + Provide strategic counsel to senior sales leadership and account teams on complex deal structures, pricing options, concessions, and negotiation strategy.
 + Act as the trusted advisor for high-risk, non-standard, and strategically significant commercial discussions.
 + Engage directly with customers on strategic, high-value negotiations when needed, representing the company with credibility.
* *AI and automation*
 + Set the vision for an AI-native deal desk, deploying agents and automation across the deal lifecycle, including deal-structuring guidance, pricing recommendations, contract and redline review, approval routing, and risk scoring.
 + Build a tiered service model where automation handles standardized, low-risk deals end to end, so the team's time goes to complex, strategic ones.
 + Scale AI-enabled workflows that improve seller productivity, deal quality, approval consistency, and speed, building on an existing foundation of deal-desk AI agents and AI-assisted deal review.
* *Deal governance and cross-functional alignment*
 + Document and enforce global approval policies, SLAs, delegation of authority, and commercial guardrails across Sales, Finance, and Legal.
 + Drive consistency of commercial policy, thresholds, and approval rules across all regions and product lines, so sellers get the same answer wherever a deal originates.
 + Own a standing deal-review and inspection cadence (deal reviews, early checkpoints, and exception tracking) that catches risk early and keeps decisions fast.
 + Partner with Finance and Revenue Accounting to ensure sound revenue recognition, revenue predictability, deal hygiene, and commercial compliance as consumption, ELA, and marketplace structures scale.
* *Deal systems and infrastructure*
 + Lead the strategy and roadmap for deal infrastructure, ensuring scalable, efficient, compliant execution as the two companies converge onto unified quote-to-order systems.
 + Partner with Systems, Legal, and Finance to deliver a unified, high-quality quoting and contracting experience across CPQ, CLM, and order management.
* *New product introduction and pricing operations*
 + Partner with Product, Pricing, and Monetization on new product introduction (NPI), making sure new products and packaging land with a clear deal construct, approval path, and field enablement at launch.
 + Oversee the Pricing Operations function, supporting packaging, SKU rationalization, and consistent, well-governed pricing execution across the portfolio.
* *Marketplace strategy and operations*
 + Oversee marketplace operations across AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake, and Databricks, ensuring a streamlined and compliant transaction experience for customers.
 + Shape policies and operational standards for our marketplace presence, and drive cross-functional alignment with Finance, Product, and vendor partners to optimize transaction efficiency and financial accuracy.

**Skills We're Looking For**

* 15+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Deal Strategy, Revenue Operations or Commercial Operations within a global SaaS or subscription-based business, or Strategy Consulting with a focus on B2B Pricing and Deal Strategy.
* 8+ years of leadership experience scaling high-performing teams, including meaningful time at the director and ideally senior director level.
* Strong command of SaaS pricing strategy, with specific depth in consumption-based pricing, commercial governance, discounting and margin considerations, and contract risk mitigation.
* Track record of building scalable deal processes, implementing robust approval frameworks, and improving deal velocity in complex, high-growth environments.
* Experience structuring deals across both direct and channel motions, including resellers and cloud marketplaces.
* Working knowledge of revenue recognition principles, with a track record of partnering closely with Finance and Revenue Accounting on deal structure.
* Experience applying AI tools to improve deal operations, approval consistency, and seller productivity.
* Proven ability to influence and collaborate with senior executives across Sales, Finance, Legal, Systems, and Product, with exceptional analytical, strategic-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Executive-level communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts simply and persuasively.
* Experience with the commercial tooling a deal process runs on (CPQ, CRM, CLM, and related sales systems), enough to be a strong partner to Systems on what is feasible; specific platform experience such as Salesforce or Ironclad is a plus, not a requirement.
* Experience leading through M&A, systems integration, or large-scale organizational change is a strong plus.

#LIHYBRID #LI-SR1

**Perks and Benefits**

* 100% employer-paid medical insurance**\***
* Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
* RSU stock grants\*
* Professional development and training opportunities
* Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
* Monthly cell phone stipend
* Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

* *May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information*

*Click* *here* *to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.*

We're honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we're proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

To learn more about Fivetran's culture and what it's like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video.

To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here.

*We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this* *form**. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.*
